heading: What interrupts it

heading: Library plan
detail: Deep Forest Hermit produces bodies and Fyndhorn Elves supplies mana. An existing board can pressure opponents or fund an expensive spell.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Each creature used for affinity reduces generic cost without tapping. A large creature board can make Army of the Damned cheaper; it cannot pay the black pips. Deploy other cards: Insidious Fungus, The Gitrog, Ravenous Ride. Own alternate payment: Grim Haruspex, Sprout Swarm. Spell discounts: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma. Hand ability: Festering Thicket.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Affinity for creatures helps cast Witherbloom and then discounts instants and sorceries such as Army of the Damned. Losing the board makes that high end expensive again. Overlap with the library: Spell discounts (1 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Castle Locthwain, Cleopatra, Exiled Pharaoh. Entry draw: Elvish Visionary. Untap support: Beledros Witherbloom, Gwenna, Eyes of Gaea. Copy / imprint: Springheart Nantuko. Token production: Arachnogenesis, Army of the Damned.

heading: Recovery
detail: Haruspex can draw from another nontoken creature dying. Seasons Past rebuilds a hand with different mana values; those cards still need casting. Recover other cards: Mosswood Dreadknight // Dread Whispers, Seasons Past. Own-card reuse: Army of the Damned, Spider Spawning.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Reducing the creature count makes affinity less effective. Exile also denies the death-trigger draw that a destroy effect may allow.

heading: Library plan
detail: Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident turn ordinary Merfolk into a threatening team; Harbinger of the Seas can make islandwalk relevant.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Stonybrook Banneret discounts Merfolk and Wizard spells, while Sapphire Medallion discounts blue spells. Neither removes the blue mana symbols in a noncreature spell's cost that Namor checks. Deploy other cards: Reenact the Crime. Own alternate payment: Fierce Guardianship, Junk Winder. Spell discounts: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia, Sapphire Medallion.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Blue symbols in your noncreature spells now produce Merfolk, and every Merfolk adds to Namor's power. A spell-heavy hand can still build a board. Overlap with the library: Token production (8 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Agna Qel'a, Attuma, Atlantean Warlord. Untap support: Forensic Researcher, Frantic Search. Copy / imprint: Fated Infatuation, Mnemonic Deluge. Token production: Deeproot Pilgrimage, Deeproot Waters.

heading: Recovery
detail: Discovery can draw on an entry or attack from the chosen type; Oracle needs Merfolk to deal combat damage to a player. Only one needs to connect. No library card tagged for these routes.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: A stalled attack hurts the combat-draw plan. Namor can still make Merfolk through the blue symbols in noncreature spells.

heading: Library plan
detail: Felidar Retreat and Court of Grace build tokens independently; Anointed Procession rewards either source.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Token production is the alternative to casting every attacker individually. Court of Grace can keep making bodies and Felidar Retreat can turn later land drops into bodies even after Suki is removed. Own alternate payment: March of the Multitudes. Hand ability: Boseiju, Who Endures.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Suki converts your creature count into her own power and adds an attacking Ally whenever she attacks. Going wide can also threaten one player with commander damage. Overlap with the library: Token production (42 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Caretaker's Talent, Court of Grace. Untap support: Reconnaissance. Copy / imprint: Battle for Bretagard, Caretaker's Talent. Token production: Aligned Heart, Andúril, Flame of the West.

heading: Recovery
detail: Court creates bodies without another creature in play. Visitation upgrades token creation but produces none on its own. Fungal Rebirth can retrieve a permanent card to hand. Recover other cards: Fungal Rebirth.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Clearing the creatures shrinks Suki. Removing the surviving token source matters more than destroying its latest token.

heading: Library plan
detail: Arbor Elf and Circle of Dreams Druid accelerate creature deployment; Beast Whisperer can refill while you build toward Craterhoof Behemoth.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Yeva changes when green creatures can be cast, not what they cost. Arbor Elf or Circle of Dreams Druid funds development while Yeva lets the player wait to see whether that mana is needed elsewhere. Deploy other cards: Smuggler's Surprise. Own alternate payment: Chord of Calling. Spell discounts: Defiler of Vigor.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Yeva lets green creatures be cast at instant speed. The same mana can represent an answer during combat or an end-step threat if no answer is needed.

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Beast Whisperer, Garruk's Uprising. Entry draw: Garruk's Uprising, Regal Force. Untap support: Arbor Elf, Deserted Temple. Token production: Titan of Industry, Worldspine Wurm.

heading: Recovery
detail: Whisperer rewards casting a creature; Project rewards a qualifying nontoken creature entering. Returning a creature card to hand with Peerless Recycling is access, not free deployment. Recover other cards: Peerless Recycling. Own-card reuse: Fanatic of Rhonas. Return own to hand: Kogla, the Titan Ape, Quirion Ranger.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Removal before the next spell closes Yeva's timing permission. A spell already cast with flash stays on the stack.

heading: Library plan
detail: Counterspell and Beast Within answer threats while Guttersnipe converts instants and sorceries into damage around the table.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: A tapped Kalamax copies the first instant each turn. Mizzix's Mastery takes a different route: it exiles an instant or sorcery from the graveyard and allows its copy to be cast without its mana cost. Deploy other cards: Mizzix's Mastery. Own alternate payment: Bolt Bend, Deflecting Swat. Hand ability: Ketria Triome.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: A tapped Kalamax copies the first instant you cast each turn, including opponents' turns. Copying instants also grows him into a combat threat. Overlap with the library: Copy / imprint (5 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Archmage Emeritus, Mystic Remora. Untap support: Frantic Search, Seedborn Muse. Copy / imprint: Arcane Bombardment, Display of Power. Token production: Prizefight, Storm-Kiln Artist.

heading: Recovery
detail: Sanctuary can put a used instant or sorcery on top if it enters untapped. Snapcaster can grant flashback now, but the spell still needs mana. Recover other cards: Arcane Bombardment, Mystic Sanctuary.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: The copy requires a tapped Kalamax and the first instant that turn. Forcing an early, low-impact instant can consume that opportunity.

heading: Library plan
detail: Archmage Emeritus draws off instants and sorceries, while Kambal, Consul of Allocation drains life on opposing noncreature casts.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: The commander rewards noncreature spells by mana value, not mana spent. Reanimate is another route to a high-value creature, but its own low mana value does not meet the commander's damage-trigger threshold. Deploy other cards: Reanimate, Sevinne's Reclamation. Own alternate payment: Snuff Out. Spell discounts: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat, Geist of Saint Thalia.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Y'shtola turns your noncreature spells of mana value three or more into table damage and lifegain. If any player lost at least four life that turn, she draws at the end step. Overlap with the library: Recurring draw (10 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Alphinaud Leveilleur, Archmage Emeritus. Untap support: Frantic Search, Unwind. Copy / imprint: Sevinne's Reclamation. Token production: Black Market Connections, Circle of Power.

heading: Recovery
detail: Reanimate can restore a creature; Reclamation brings back a permanent of mana value three or less. The recovery targets are not interchangeable. Recover other cards: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat, Reanimate. Own-card reuse: Sevinne's Reclamation.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Holding life loss below four for each player denies the end-step draw. Countering a noncreature spell after it is cast does not undo its cast trigger.

heading: Library plan

That is deployment from the command zone without paying six mana for the commander; the original Vampire spell can still be countered. Own alternate payment: Hagra Mauling. Hand ability: Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire, Savai Triome.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Edgar already makes a token when you cast another Vampire from the command zone. Casting him adds an immediate hasty attack that can put a counter on every Vampire you control. Overlap with the library: Token production (12 cards).

heading: Resource reuse

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Exile can bypass death payoffs. Removing Edgar from the battlefield alone does not turn off eminence once he is back in the command zone.

heading: Library plan
detail: Gemhide Sliver lets changelings make mana, and Cloudshredder Sliver gives them haste and flying. Those shared-type payoffs work without resolving the commander.

heading: Alternate routes

Deploy other cards: Realmwalker. Own alternate payment: Omni-Changeling. Spell discounts: Morophon, the Boundless. Hand ability: Indatha Triome, Ketria Triome.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Eminence already discounts other Dragon spells, including changelings. Once on the field, attacking Dragons draw cards and can put a permanent from hand onto the battlefield. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (1 cards).

heading: Resource reuse

Recover other cards: Graveshifter, Haven of the Spirit Dragon. Blink / return: Eerie Interlude, Personify. Return own to hand: Flock Impostor, Hibernation Sliver.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: A resolved wipe removes the team that enables an attack payoff. The commander discount persists in the command zone but does not replace those cards.

heading: Library plan
detail: Deepglow Skate and Evolution Sage add counters to existing permanents, so the planeswalkers can build loyalty without Atraxa.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Build loyalty before Atraxa arrives. A Deepglow Skate entry can double counters that already exist without waiting for Atraxa's end step. Deploy other cards: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth, Tamiyo, Field Researcher. Hand ability: Ash Barrens.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: At your end step Atraxa proliferates across the board. She advances several walkers at once, but needs counters already in place.

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Tamiyo, Field Researcher, Tamiyo, the Moon Sage. Untap support: Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. Copy / imprint: Spark Double. Token production: Elspeth, Knight-Errant, Elspeth, Sun's Champion.

heading: Recovery
detail: Witness retrieves one card to hand; Rebirth returns legendary permanents directly to the field, provided a legendary creature or planeswalker lets you cast it. Recover other cards: Eternal Witness, Kaya the Inexorable. Blink / return: Oath of Teferi, Semester's End. Return own to hand: Dimir Aqueduct, Golgari Rot Farm.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Removing walkers before the end step leaves Atraxa fewer loyalty counters to proliferate. Proliferate cannot put the first counter on a permanent.

heading: Library plan

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Goblin Warchief can reduce the generic cost of a Goblin spell and give the resulting creature haste. Krenko's activation creates bodies without casting them and benefits from having Goblins in place first. Own alternate payment: Goblin Taskmaster. Spell discounts: Goblin Warchief. Hand ability: Skinbrand Goblin.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Krenko's tap ability makes a Goblin for each Goblin you control. Chieftain's haste lets him use it immediately, but an empty board limits the first activation. Overlap with the library: Token production (11 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Untap support: Goatnapper. Token production: Beetleback Chief, Dragon Fodder.

heading: Recovery
detail: Warchief supplies haste and reduces Goblin spell costs. After a wipe, Ringleader can refill from Goblins in the top four; it does not return the lost board. Own-card reuse: Direct Current, Squee, the Immortal.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Krenko counts Goblins as his activation resolves. Removing bodies in response cuts the yield; removing only Krenko does not counter the activation.

heading: Library plan
detail: Goblin Electromancer discounts instants and sorceries, and Guttersnipe damages each opponent as you cast them. The spellslinger plan can run without Vivi.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Goblin Electromancer can make the first spell easier to cast. Vivi produces mana based on power after the deck has already started casting noncreature spells; that mana burst is not a permanent discount. Own alternate payment: Blasphemous Act, Deflecting Swat. Spell discounts: Artist's Talent, Goblin Electromancer. Hand ability: Shark Typhoon.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Noncreature casts grow Vivi and ping the table. Once on your turn, Vivi converts that power into blue and/or red mana for another sequence of spells.

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Chandra, Chill of Compliance, Mystic Remora. Entry draw: Quantum Riddler. Untap support: Gandalf the Grey, Insurrection. Copy / imprint: Gandalf the Grey, Sword of Wealth and Power. Token production: Hermes, Overseer of Elpis, Namor the Sub-Mariner.

heading: Recovery
detail: Electromancer reduces generic costs on instants and sorceries. The Flamer can return a random instant or sorcery at upkeep, not necessarily the spell you need. Recover other cards: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch. Own-card reuse: Vivi's Persistence.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Interrupt before Vivi's mana activation or remove the payoffs for repeated casting. Cheap spells alone are not a sustained draw engine.

heading: Library plan
detail: Dunland Crebain builds an Army, and Mauhur, Uruk-hai Captain can increase its counters. Massacre Wurm can punish smaller opposing boards without an attack.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Nightscape Familiar discounts blue and red spells. Zombify instead deploys a creature from your graveyard; the printed mana value of the creature does not determine the cost of Zombify. Deploy other cards: Extract from Darkness, Sauron, Lord of the Rings. Spell discounts: Nightscape Familiar. Hand ability: Ash Barrens, Seething Landscape.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Opponents' spells repeatedly grow your Army. If it hits a player, the Ring tempts you and Sauron can exchange your hand for four cards. Overlap with the library: Token production (31 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Moria Scavenger. Copy / imprint: Sauron, the Necromancer. Token production: Assault on Osgiliath, Barad-dûr.

heading: Recovery
detail: Zombify needs a creature card in your graveyard. Extract mills first and can use a creature card from any graveyard, even if your own has no good target. Recover other cards: Extract from Darkness, Gathering of Darkness. Own-card reuse: Ringwraiths, Summons of Saruman.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Prevent Army combat damage to interrupt hand replacement. That does not prevent opposing spells from growing the Army.

heading: Library plan
detail: Hedron Crab stocks the graveyard. Life from the Loam retrieves lands for more landfall triggers, including Evolution Sage's proliferate.

heading: Alternate routes

Teval's attack returns a land card from the graveyard, not an arbitrary threat; Living Death is the much broader but symmetrical creature-deployment route. Deploy other cards: Cultivator Colossus, Floral Evoker. Own alternate payment: Amanda Grayson, Logic's Link. Hand ability: Fetid Pools, Foreboding Landscape.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Attacking mills three and can put a land from the graveyard onto the field. When one or more cards leave your graveyard, Teval also supplies a Zombie Druid. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (5 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Slate of Ancestry, Thrór's Map. Untap support: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom. Copy / imprint: Colossal Clone Master, Scute Swarm. Token production: Avenger of Zendikar, Crawling Sensation.

heading: Recovery
detail: Excavator plays lands from the graveyard; Loam moves them to hand. Living Death exchanges battlefield creatures for graveyard creatures, including opponents' creatures. Recover other cards: Ancient Greenwarden, Conduit of Worlds. Own-card reuse: Drownyard Temple, Echo of Eons. Return own to hand: Golgari Rot Farm.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Exiling the graveyard before reanimation denies the stored threats. Ordinary destruction can instead stock the next recovery play.

heading: Library plan
detail: Faithless Looting can put a large threat in the graveyard for Reanimate; it need not wait for Kaalia or enough mana to hard-cast it.

heading: Alternate routes
detail: Attacking with Kaalia puts a qualifying creature from hand onto the field tapped and attacking, not onto the stack as a spell. Sneak Attack spends red mana instead and carries a delayed sacrifice; Reanimate uses the graveyard and costs life. Deploy other cards: Animate Dead, Necromancy. Own alternate payment: Deadly Rollick, Deflecting Swat.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: An attack on an opponent can put an Angel, Demon or Dragon such as Avacyn straight from hand into combat. She need not connect, but she does need an eligible card in hand. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (5 cards).

heading: Resource reuse
detail: Recurring draw: Archivist of Oghma, Esper Sentinel. Untap support: Aggravated Assault. Copy / imprint: Sevinne's Reclamation. Token production: Ancient Copper Dragon, Orcish Bowmasters.

heading: Recovery
detail: Sneak Attack uses a creature in hand even when Kaalia cannot attack. Reanimate and Animate Dead instead need a creature card already in a graveyard. Recover other cards: Animate Dead, Necromancy. Own-card reuse: Faithless Looting, Sevinne's Reclamation.

heading: What interrupts it
detail: Precombat removal closes the attack route; graveyard hate closes the reanimation route. Neither by itself answers the other.

detail: Clavileño needs a qualifying Vampire attack to mark a creature, and the marked creature must die for its payoff. Exile separates those two events.

Deploy other cards: Growth Spiral, Nicanzil, Current Conductor. Own alternate payment: Ravenform. Spell discounts: Stonybrook Banneret.

heading: Commander dependence
detail: Hakbal makes each of your Merfolk explore at the beginning of your combat. Attacking with Hakbal adds another choice: put a land from hand onto the field or draw. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (3 cards).

heading: Entry trigger
detail: An enters-the-battlefield condition appears in a trigger. It can refer to this card or to another permanent entering.

heading: Death / leave trigger
detail: The trigger names dying or leaving the battlefield. Death requires a creature to go from the battlefield to a graveyard; other leave triggers can work on exile.

heading: Attack trigger
detail: The event is declaring an attack. Unlike combat damage, this does not require an attacker to connect.

heading: Combat damage trigger
detail: The event requires dealing combat damage. Check whether the recipient must be a player.

heading: Cast trigger
detail: The event is casting a spell. Simply putting a permanent onto the battlefield is not casting it.

heading: Upkeep / end-step trigger
detail: A trigger is tied to a particular upkeep or end step; it is not immediately available on deployment.

heading: Sacrifice to activate
detail: Sacrificing a permanent is part of an activation cost. The paid resource is gone before opponents can respond to the ability.

heading: Instant / flash face
detail: An instant face, flash, or explicit permission to cast this card as though it had flash. Other modes and faces may have different timing.

heading: Sorcery face
detail: At least one face is a sorcery; permissions and alternative faces may change what is available.

heading: Permanent setup
detail: The library face is a nonland permanent. Activated and triggered effects may need that permanent to resolve and remain in play.

heading: Land play
detail: A front-face land. Playing a land is not casting a spell; mana and nonmana abilities have their own requirements.

heading: Activated ability
detail: Printed cost-and-effect wording with a colon, including mana and loyalty abilities; not an assertion of immediate usability.

heading: Triggered ability
detail: Printed when, whenever, or beginning/end-of-event wording. Check the trigger and any intervening condition.

heading: Loyalty ability
detail: Planeswalker with an activated ability. Starting loyalty, sorcery timing and loyalty costs matter.

heading: Ability from hand
detail: The card has a hand ability such as cycling or channel. The activation is not casting its spell face.

heading: Restricted timing
detail: Printed once-per-turn, sorcery-only, or other explicit timing restriction. Read the affected clause.

heading: Instant / flash spell
detail: At least one castable face is an instant or has flash. Not the timing of every face, nor a guarantee of available mana.

heading: Own alternate payment
detail: Explicit alternate cost, self-discount, evoke, foretell, suspend, prototype, affinity or similar. Can still require setup, payment or delayed access.

heading: Deploy other cards
detail: Moves other cards into play by an alternative route, including reanimation. Not all routes are free. Includes commander routes and high-gate abilities.

heading: Spell discounts
detail: Reduces other spell costs, distinct from producing mana and from activated-ability discounts.

heading: Ability discounts
detail: Reduces or replaces an activated/equip cost, not spell costs.

heading: Hand ability
detail: Channel, cycling or ninjutsu options; not spells cast for their printed face cost.

heading: Destroy
detail: Destruction coverage; generally stopped by indestructible. Costs, targeting and restrictions still apply.

heading: Exile / sacrifice
detail: Battlefield exile or forced sacrifice/exile choices. Conditional until-leaves exile is included; not every case is permanent or targeted.

heading: Bounce / tuck
detail: Returns opposing resources to hand/library; usually temporary denial rather than card elimination.

heading: Damage / shrink
detail: Damage, fight or negative toughness can remove creatures of suitable size; not an unconditional kill.

heading: Tap / disable
detail: Tap, prevent untapping, or disable attacks/abilities. Some cards prevent untapping without doing the tapping.

heading: Temporary exile / phase
detail: Short-term exile/return or phasing, not permanent removal.

heading: Steal / transform
detail: Change control or neutralize abilities/types. Does not inherently remove the card.

heading: Counter / stack
detail: Interact with spells or abilities already on the stack; includes noncounter answers with different restrictions.

heading: Multi-permanent reset
detail: Can remove multiple battlefield permanents with a sweep/overload/mode. May be conditional or symmetric; not necessarily a complete wipe.

heading: Taxes / restrictions
detail: Restrict casting, activation, untapping, drawing or combat, or impose resource taxes. Does not mean a complete lock.

heading: Protect board
detail: Protect other owned permanents via a printed protective effect. Not an exhaustive count of defensive keywords on individual threats.

heading: Graveyard disruption
detail: Direct graveyard removal, replacement, or access restriction. Scope ranges from one card to whole graveyards.

heading: Enable targeting / damage
detail: Remove hexproof/shroud/indestructible as specified by the card; requires another effect to answer the permanent.

heading: Combat prevention / redirection
detail: Prevent combat damage, stop attacks, or redirect attackers. Not permanent removal or a general combo answer.

heading: Hand disruption
detail: Can cause an opposing player to discard or exile a hand card; includes conditional, symmetrical and choice-based modes. Self-only filtering is excluded.

heading: Recover other cards
detail: Can return/recast other used cards, including narrow targets, death triggers and high-gate ultimates. Graveyard access can be disrupted.

heading: Own-card reuse
detail: Can a card can reuse itself. Usually conditional or finite, not necessarily an engine by itself.

heading: Blink / return
detail: Reuse a surviving permanent through exile/return. Usually does not recover a lost permanent; tokens do not return.

heading: Copy / imprint
detail: Copy a permanent/spell/ability or replay an imprinted copy. Needs a valid source; not automatically a replacement for a destroyed engine.

heading: Untap support
detail: Can untap resources. Can enable repeated nonmana abilities as well as mana production; may be gated.

heading: Recurring draw
detail: Repeated opportunities to draw. Trigger costs, caps and dependencies still apply; counts are not cards drawn per turn.

heading: Entry draw
detail: A draw-on-entry permanent. Can become recurring if this deck can reuse it; does not itself imply a repeatable loop.

heading: Token production
detail: Can create tokens for you, including creature, mana and other artifact tokens. Pure replacements/multipliers and gift-token removal are excluded. Setup and ultimate gates still apply.

heading: Token modifiers
detail: Changes or multiplies a token-creation event without being a token source on its own.

heading: Return own to hand
detail: Can retrieve a surviving owned permanent to recast, or return itself to hand. Not graveyard recovery and not a free replay.

heading: Creatures
detail: A mode can affect an opposing creature.

heading: Artifacts
detail: A mode can affect an opposing artifact.

heading: Enchantments
detail: A mode can affect an opposing enchantment.

heading: Planeswalkers
detail: A mode can affect an opposing planeswalker.

heading: Lands
detail: A mode can affect an opposing land; restricted targets count.

heading: Graveyards
detail: Can disrupt access to a graveyard, including a single card.

heading: Hands
detail: Can reduce or constrain an opposing hand.

heading: Stack spells
detail: Can answer a spell before it resolves.

heading: Stack abilities
detail: Can answer an activated or triggered ability on the stack.

heading: Repeatable mana rock
detail: Noncreature, nonland artifact with a printed mana ability that does not sacrifice itself. Includes filtering rocks and conditional activations.

heading: Mana creature
detail: Nonland creature with a printed repeatable add-mana activation. Does not count every way to grant another creature a mana ability.

heading: One-shot mana
detail: A spell that adds mana directly or a nonland permanent that sacrifices itself for mana. Treasure producers are not automatically fast mana.

heading: Land search to hand
detail: Search for a land or named basic land type and put it into hand, including landcycling. This helps land drops but does not itself put an extra land onto the battlefield.

heading: Land search to field
detail: Library land search that puts a land onto the battlefield; includes fetch lands and tapped arrivals. Not all are net acceleration.

heading: Fetch land
detail: Land sacrificed to search the library for a land to put onto the battlefield.

heading: Grant flash to others
detail: A printed effect lets other cards or spells be cast with flash timing. Count separately from a card having flash itself.

heading: Interaction-capable
detail: Distinct cards with any tagged interaction target or method. The union, not the sum of columns.

heading: Instant / flash interaction
detail: Interaction-capable cards with an instant or flash face. Not every mode of every face works at instant speed.

heading: Permanent-based interaction
detail: Interaction-capable cards with a permanent type other than land. May require resolution, another cost or a later trigger.

heading: Hand ability interaction
detail: Interaction-capable cards also tagged with an ability from hand. Check the card: the interactive mode need not be that same ability.
